memory_candidates.content: Downstream Lean projects place Mathlib-bound generic code under a dedicated directory with three observed spellings: PFR/ForMathlib/, LeanLTL/ForMathlib.lean, SphereEversion/ToMathlib/, FLT/Mathlib/. The Mathlib style guide says nothing about such files.

Pinned Mathlib (v4.33.0-rc1) has no Stone representation theorem for Boolean algebras and no Priestley duality: Order/Birkhoff.lean covers only the finite case, Topology/Order/Priestley.lean defines only the PriestleySpace mixin, and Order/PrimeSeparator.lean carries a commented TODO to define prime filters.
